people.name: Aenon
people.line: A place near Salim where John the Baptist baptized.

people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

people.name: Salim
people.line: Place near Aenon where John the Baptist baptized

translations.web: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came, and were baptized;
translations.bsb: Now John was also baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because the water was plentiful there, and people kept coming to be baptized.
translations.kjv: And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
translations.asv: And John also was baptizing in Enon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
